name: Project OWL — Illegal Owl Trade (COMPLETE: Nexus 5 + HD1 companion computer)

peirce_chain.firstness: Mobile device contains accounts on multiple communication platforms (Google, Musical.ly, Skype, Twitter, Facebook, Snapchat) with owl-related search history and browsing of birdtrader.co.uk owl sale listings.
peirce_chain.secondness: Musical.ly chat messages show direct negotiation between Sarah McAvoy (sarahmcavoy) and Layla Aster (layster82) involving: (1) request for email contact to coordinate transaction, (2) exchange of owl image with 'How do you like him', (3) buyer verification 'is that the exact one you have'. CM Security AppLock deployed to protect communication apps. Anti-forensic consciousness demonstrated.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Across two of the subject's own devices, the same deliberate owl-trade preparation appears: on the Nexus 5 a negotiation with a known seller (layster82) over Musical.ly with app compartmentalization; on the HD1 companion computer, browsing of specific owl for-sale listings on birdtrader.co.uk, owl husbandry materials, Pidgin under the same account, and deletion of owl files. Two independent devices for the same subject and the same objective establish deliberate, premeditated participation in illegal wildlife trade (INTENT). MALICE is not reached: no completed transaction or payment record is present on either device, and the HD1 deletions are recoverable soft-deletes.

caie_fractures.description: Owl trade discussed exclusively on Musical.ly (protected by AppLock), while Skype conversations explicitly excluded trade topics per scenario design. This compartmentalization indicates awareness that the activity was illicit.

CM Security AppLock installed specifically to protect Musical.ly and Snapchat. Subject deleted prior email thread with Layla ('I accidentally deleted the string of emails we sent'). Device rooted with TWRP/SuperSU. Encryption disabled — potentially to facilitate wipe/reset.
Independent second device (HD1 HP computer) for the same subject Sarah McAvoy shows the same owl-purchase preparation, corroborating the phone and satisfying the two-source bar.
On HD1, Pidgin automatic chat logging was enabled but no conversation logs exist and the buddy list is empty; owl images and PDFs were deleted to the Recycle Bin.
